objective: Decode the render device wrapper vtable slots.
question: What does each slot of the 0x476C2C render device vtable do?
method: Full slot dump 0x476C2C-0x476C58 + 14-instr disasm head per slot.

slots.0x00: delegate 4 args to [obj+0x78] target vtbl+0xC (fallback self vtbl+0xC), ret 0x10
slots.0x02: windowed adjust: bit0 of [0x2C] -> release [0x48]/[0x50] or SetRect screen metrics
slots.0x04: pause flag: arg in {1,4} -> [0x40]=0 else 1, tick

audit_vs_exe.F1055: render device vtable boundary corrected to 9 slots (float tail excluded)
audit_vs_exe.F310: screen object (screen+0x6214 minimap etc.) sits above this wrapper
audit_vs_exe.F1011: 0x45E8E0 ground blit lives in the same 0x45Exxx region as slot 0

contrast.windowed_vs_fullscreen: bit0 of [0x2C] branches release vs metrics

verdict: Render device wrapper closed at slot level: message handling, mode/windowed adjust, 640x480x16 reset path with lost-device flag, client-rect inset, timer arm - the substrate beneath the screen object.
evidence_level_note: All slots disassembled from .text; constants inline.
reproduce: dump 0x476C2C words; disasm each of 9 slots +0x40
